app.title: Merman Playground
app.description: Online Mermaid diagram editor powered by Rust + WebAssembly

build.description: Playground is built from this source checkout. Its package version may match a release while containing different changes.

features.reloadDescription: Reload the page to request this feature again.

export.title: Export
export.invalidBackground: Background must be a six-digit hex color.
export.asciiNotSupported: ASCII export not supported for this diagram type

share.title: Share
share.workspaceLinkDesc: Restores the render workspace on the recipient's device.
share.issueLinkDesc: Restores this page, editor tab, Preview mode, SVG presentation, and Bounds preference.
share.issueViewNotRestored: Issue reproduction context could not be restored. Local view defaults are being used.
share.externalThemeLimit: Mermaid.ink and Mermaid Live links omit Merman visual presets and custom themes.
share.themeNotIncluded: Merman theme was not included. Use a workspace link or export SVG to preserve it.

bench.title: Browser Benchmark
bench.description: Balanced Merman and Mermaid measurements in isolated browser runtimes. Fresh runtime samples may reuse the HTTP cache; cache observations are reported separately.
bench.realmColdDescription: Each measured sample rebuilds a separate iframe and module state. The primary result uses one parent clock from sample dispatch through strict SVG validation; bootstrap and HTTP cache observations remain separate.
bench.warmDescription: Each engine keeps its own isolated iframe, receives the same number of real-source warmups, then is measured repeatedly to the same strict parent-side SVG boundary.
bench.cancelledShowingPrevious: The latest run was cancelled. Showing the previous result.
bench.staleDescription: This run keeps its frozen source and options. Current editor changes will render after the benchmark releases the live coordinator.
bench.preparing: Pausing live rendering and preparing isolated runtimes
bench.setupEvidenceDescription: Parent-clock artifact acquisition and isolated-runtime bootstrap finish before the isolated-runtime sample clock. They are retained separately and are not presented as network-cold evidence.
bench.rawEvidenceDescription: Failed and warmup samples remain inspectable here and in the downloaded report; they never enter measured aggregates.
bench.noSamples: No sample completed before the terminal event.
bench.failureEvidenceDescription: Each failure remains attributed to the engine and stage that produced it.

metricDescriptions.firstPublishableSvgMs: One parent clock from dispatch to a fresh isolated runtime through response-envelope checks and the same strict SVG projector used by the Playground.
metricDescriptions.warmPublishableSvgMs: One parent clock from dispatch to a reused isolated runtime through response-envelope checks and the same strict SVG projector used by the Playground.

examples.title: Example Gallery
examples.description: Select an example to load into the editor
examples.searchPlaceholder: Search title, type, alias, or source
examples.empty: No examples match the current filters.

hover.flowchart: Declares a flowchart. Common directions are TD, LR, BT, and RL.
hover.graph: Alternative flowchart header used by Mermaid.
hover.sequenceDiagram: Declares a sequence diagram for message flows between participants.
hover.classDiagram: Declares a class diagram with classes, members, and relationships.
hover.stateDiagram: Declares a state diagram using the v2 state syntax.
hover.journey: Declares a user journey diagram with sections, tasks, scores, and actors.
hover.info: Declares an info diagram for Mermaid runtime/version information.
hover.zenuml: Declares a ZenUML diagram with family-owned grammar and typed headless rendering.
hover.xychart: Declares an XY chart with x-axis, y-axis, bar, and line series.
hover.architecture: Declares an architecture diagram with groups, services, and edges.
hover.c4: Declares a C4 diagram such as C4Context or C4Container.
hover.block: Declares a block diagram with grid columns and block relationships.
hover.packet: Declares a packet diagram where each row describes a bit field.
hover.kanban: Declares a kanban board with columns and item metadata.
hover.quadrant: Declares a quadrant chart with axis labels, quadrants, and points.
hover.sankey: Declares a Sankey diagram using source,target,value rows.
hover.radar: Declares a radar chart with axes and curves.
hover.treemap: Declares a treemap using indentation to represent hierarchy.
hover.requirement: Declares a requirement diagram. Avoid commas in unquoted text fields.
hover.eventmodeling: Declares an Event Modeling diagram with timeframes, reset frames, and event streams.
hover.subgraph: Starts a flowchart subgraph. Close it with end.

preview.title: Preview
preview.asciiNotSupported: ASCII not supported for this diagram type
preview.asciiDetectionUnavailable: ASCII rendering was not attempted because the diagram type could not be detected

svgPipelineDescriptions.parity: For browsers and Webviews. Preserves Mermaid HTML labels and styles.
svgPipelineDescriptions.readable: Adds SVG text for consumers that ignore HTML labels. May show duplicate text in browsers.
svgPipelineDescriptions.resvg-safe: For resvg/usvg consumers. Converts HTML labels and cleans unsupported styles and content.

svgPipelineGuidance.browserWarning: Text fallback SVG keeps HTML labels and adds SVG text. Both can appear in this browser preview and overlap.

customTheme.tooLarge: Theme JSON must be {{limit}} KiB or smaller.

themePanel.noneDescription: Use the Mermaid theme and source styles only. The diagram may still have a background.
themePanel.validRecipeRequired: Fix the recipe before exporting it.
themePanel.unknownPreset: Unavailable in this runtime: {{id}}. The saved selection is preserved.
themePanel.compatibilityHint: Changes both engines immediately. Authored configuration and source styles can take precedence. Cancel only discards the Merman selection below.
themePanel.fontPrecedenceHint: Chosen diagram font: {{font}}. This font is passed to both engines and may override a preset's font stack. Explicit config and source font settings can take precedence.
themePanel.applyFirst: Apply the theme draft before sharing or exporting the preview.
themePanel.invalidPreview: Invalid JSON. Preview uses the last valid theme with the current diagram.
themePanel.draftPreview: Theme preview. Apply to use this selection.
themePanel.evidenceUnavailable: No execution evidence is available for this SVG.
themePanel.evidenceExplanation: These results describe this SVG execution. Preset design scope and runtime support are separate; an empty diagnostic list does not certify portability.
themePanel.compareStyled: Merman applies its selected preset or custom recipe. Mermaid.js receives the Mermaid source and config. Choose None in the theme panel for a comparison without Merman styling.
themePanel.previewBackingHint: Display only; excluded from image exports. A transparency grid reveals transparent regions without removing theme paint.
themePanel.title: Theme panel
themePanel.jsonHint: Read-only. Create or refine a theme with $design-merman-theme, then import the updated JSON.
themePanel.noRecipe: Select a preset or import a theme to view its JSON.
themePanel.importHint: Import a theme JSON file to preview it here. Use $design-merman-theme to create or refine a theme.
themePanel.previewHint: Selections preview in Merman only. Apply saves this styling for exports and shared links; Cancel restores the last applied Merman styling.
themePanel.layeringHint: Merman styling layers over the Mermaid base theme. Authored configuration, frontmatter, directives and source styles may override the result. Selecting a preset keeps your source, look and layout settings.
themePanel.swatchHint: Swatches come from each preset's recipe colors. The current diagram preview shows the resulting appearance.
themePanel.catalogUnavailable: The theme catalog is unavailable. It will load when the renderer is ready.
themePanel.renderInput: Theme used by the displayed render
themePanel.invalidDraft: Invalid theme. Showing the last valid theme.
themePanel.familyWaiting: Current diagram: waiting for this render's detection…
themePanel.familyUnknown: The current diagram family could not be detected.
themePanel.noReviewedFamilies: No diagram families are listed as reviewed for this preset.
themePanel.reviewedFamiliesHint: Dedicated design adds family-specific styling; base styling uses the shared appearance. Unlisted families and unknown treatments are not yet reviewed, which does not mean unsupported. Review describes design intent; the actual scene and output target still matter.
themePanel.recommendedConfigHint: This button merges the shown keys into Mermaid config, preserving unrelated settings. Config changes apply to both engines immediately and survive Cancel. Source configuration may still override them.
themePanel.recommendedApplied: Recommended settings applied to Mermaid config. Source configuration may still override them.
themePanel.recommendedConfigError: Could not update Mermaid config. Fix its JSON object and try again. {{error}}
themePanel.sameRenderHint: These observations belong only to the current inputs and this render. Theme application and target or host compatibility are separate checks.

waiting.render: Waiting for the current diagram and theme to finish rendering…
waiting.importing: Reading the theme file. Waiting for a validated selection and its render…
waiting.validating: Validating the theme. Waiting for its render…
waiting.invalid: Fix or replace the invalid theme to see its outcome. The preview retains the last valid theme.

outcome.applied: Theme applied. The renderer verified theme application for this SVG.
outcome.residual: Theme application has residuals. Some styling remains conditional or unverified in this SVG.
outcome.incomplete: Theme application is incomplete. Some requested styling was not fully applied.
outcome.not_present: No Merman theme application was reported for this SVG. Mermaid and source styling may still be present.
outcome.failed: The current Merman render failed. No completed theme result is available for this selection.
outcome.unavailable: Theme evidence is missing or not recognized for this SVG. Application has not been confirmed.

themePanel.diagnosticReasonsUnknown: Renderer diagnostic: {{code}}. See Advanced for the original details.

diagnosticReasons.unsupported-effect: A requested effect, such as a shadow or glow, could not be applied to this diagram, look or shape. Review Application notes for any listed requirements.
diagnosticReasons.unsupported-typography: Some requested font or text styling could not be applied in this render.
diagnosticReasons.unsupported-fill: Some requested fill paint could not be applied in this render.
diagnosticReasons.unsupported-stroke: Some requested line or border styling could not be applied in this render.
diagnosticReasons.compatibility-unverified: Some styling could not be verified for this diagram. Check the SVG in the host where you intend to use it.

themePanel.targetReasonsUnknown: Renderer target reason: {{code}}. This UI has no explanation for this code; see Advanced for the original details.

targetReasons.theme_evidence_incomplete: Theme execution evidence is incomplete. Review the styling observations above.
targetReasons.svg_terminal_unverified: The final SVG has not been verified for the requested output target.
targetReasons.svg_terminal_validation_failed: The final SVG did not pass the output target's validation.
targetReasons.host_dependent_text_layout: Text layout depends on the host's text measurement or rendering.
targetReasons.svg_fonts_not_self_contained: The SVG does not include all the fonts it needs; the host may supply them.
targetReasons.font_resolution_incomplete: Not all requested fonts could be resolved for this output.
targetReasons.system_or_host_font_dependency: This output depends on fonts supplied by the system or host.

themePanel.moreReasons_one: {{count}} more distinct reason is available in Advanced.
themePanel.moreReasons_other: {{count}} more distinct reasons are available in Advanced.

target.checked: The renderer's target checks passed for this output and these inputs. This does not establish compatibility with every host.
target.host_dependent: This output depends on the host, such as its fonts or browser rendering. Theme application alone does not remove those dependencies.
target.rejected: Target compatibility checks failed, although an SVG was returned. Inspect Advanced for the reported reasons.
target.unverified: Target compatibility was not verified for this output.
target.unavailable: No recognized target compatibility evidence is available for this output.
